blocks.zh: 液相滅菌 — 完整雙語教學版
blocks.en: Liquid-Phase Sterilization: Complete Bilingual Teaching Edition

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives / 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Understand liquid-phase sterilization (LPS) as a distinct sterilization modality using chemical agents in solution / 理解液相滅菌作為一種利用溶液中化學劑的獨特滅菌方式
blocks.en: Understand liquid-phase sterilization (LPS) as a distinct sterilization modality using chemical agents in solution

blocks.zh: Identify the major classes of chemical sterilants: aldehydes, acids, bases, oxygenating compounds, and halides / 識別主要化學滅菌劑類別：醛類、酸類、鹼類、含氧化合物與鹵化物
blocks.en: Identify the major classes of chemical sterilants: aldehydes, acids, bases, oxygenating compounds, and halides

blocks.zh: Compare the Half-Cycle and Bracketing validation approaches for liquid-phase sterilization / 比較液相滅菌的半週期法與包圍法驗證策略
blocks.en: Compare the Half-Cycle and Bracketing validation approaches for liquid-phase sterilization

blocks.zh: Recognize the importance of agent neutralization/removal while maintaining sterility post-sterilization / 認識滅菌後化學劑中和/去除的重要性，同時維持物品的無菌狀態
blocks.en: Recognize the importance of agent neutralization/removal while maintaining sterility post-sterilization

blocks.zh: Apply liquid-phase sterilization concepts to CDMO closed-system and single-use system (SUS) sterilization scenarios / 將液相滅菌概念應用於 CDMO 封閉系統與一次性使用系統（SUS）的滅菌情境
blocks.en: Apply liquid-phase sterilization concepts to CDMO closed-system and single-use system (SUS) sterilization scenarios

blocks.zh: Introduction — 導論
blocks.en: Introduction

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Liquid-Phase Sterilization（液相滅菌）：將物品浸泡在化學滅菌劑溶液中，利用化學方式破壞微生物（包括孢子）的滅菌方法。與蒸氣或乾熱等物理方式不同，這裡的殺滅機制是化學反應。
blocks.en: Liquid-Phase Sterilization: a sterilization method in which items are immersed in a solution of a chemical sterilant, which chemically destroys microorganisms (including spores). Unlike physical methods such as steam or dry heat, the kill mechanism here is a chemical reaction.

blocks.zh: 與其他滅菌方式的定位差異：
blocks.en: How it differs from other sterilization methods:

blocks.zh: Steam / 蒸氣（〈1229.1〉） — 高溫高壓，最通用
blocks.en: Steam (<1229.1>) - high temperature and pressure; the most versatile

blocks.zh: Dry Heat / 乾熱（〈1229.8〉） — 除熱原（depyrogenation）
blocks.en: Dry Heat (<1229.8>) - depyrogenation

blocks.zh: Radiation / 輻射（〈1229.10〉） — 最終包裝滅菌
blocks.en: Radiation (<1229.10>) - sterilization of final packaging

blocks.zh: Liquid-Phase / 液相（本章） — 表面浸泡滅菌，適用於無法耐受高溫的物品
blocks.en: Liquid-Phase (this chapter) - surface immersion sterilization, suited to items that cannot tolerate high temperatures

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Safety & Toxicity
blocks.en: Key Note: Safety & Toxicity

blocks.zh: 原文最後特別警告：這些化學劑具高度毒性（highly toxic）。在 CDMO 環境中，操作過氧乙酸或次氯酸鈉等試劑時，必須配備：
blocks.en: The original text closes with a specific warning: these chemical agents are highly toxic. In a CDMO environment, handling reagents such as peracetic acid or sodium hypochlorite requires:

blocks.zh: 適當的個人防護裝備（PPE）— 護目鏡、手套、面罩
blocks.en: Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE): goggles, gloves, face shield

blocks.zh: 通風設施 — 避免蒸氣吸入
blocks.en: Ventilation to avoid inhalation of vapors

blocks.zh: 洩漏應變計畫（Spill Response）
blocks.en: A spill response plan

blocks.zh: 職業安全衛生（EHS）培訓紀錄
blocks.en: Environment, health and safety (EHS) training records

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 化學滅菌劑五大類：
blocks.en: The five classes of chemical sterilants:

blocks.zh: CDMO 首選：Peracetic Acid (PAA / 過氧乙酸) — 它分解產物為醋酸和水，對環境友善，且對一次性系統材料相容性好。這是製藥業液相滅菌最常用的化學劑。
blocks.en: First choice for CDMOs: Peracetic Acid (PAA) - it breaks down into acetic acid and water, is environmentally friendly, and is highly compatible with single-use system materials. It is the chemical agent most commonly used for liquid-phase sterilization in the pharmaceutical industry.

blocks.zh: Validation of Sterilization by Liquids — 液相滅菌驗證
blocks.en: Validation of Sterilization by Liquids

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 First-Order Kinetics
blocks.en: Key Concepts: First-Order Kinetics

blocks.zh: 一級反應動力學（First-Order Kinetics）：微生物在化學滅菌劑作用下的死亡遵循一級動力學 — 意味著在對數座標上，存活微生物數量與暴露時間呈線性關係。這與蒸氣滅菌中的 D 值概念相同。
blocks.en: First-Order Kinetics: microbial death under a chemical sterilant follows first-order kinetics, meaning that on a logarithmic scale the number of surviving microorganisms is linear with exposure time. This is the same concept as the D-value in steam sterilization.

blocks.zh: 這使得驗證相對簡單：只要確認在特定條件下的殺滅速率（death rate），就能計算出達到目標 SAL（Sterility Assurance Level, 10<sup>−6</sup>）所需的暴露時間。
blocks.en: This keeps validation relatively simple: once the death rate under specific conditions is confirmed, the exposure time needed to reach the target SAL (Sterility Assurance Level, 10<sup>−6</sup>) can be calculated.

blocks.zh: Half-Cycle Approach — 半週期法
blocks.en: Half-Cycle Approach

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Half-Cycle Method
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Half-Cycle Method

blocks.zh: 半週期法的運作邏輯：
blocks.en: How the half-cycle approach works:

blocks.zh: 驗證階段：在一半的暴露時間（half cycle）內，證明能完全殺滅所有生物指示劑（total kill）
blocks.en: Validation phase: demonstrate complete kill of all biological indicators (total kill) within half of the exposure time (the half cycle)

blocks.zh: 常規操作：將暴露時間加倍（full cycle），提供額外的安全餘量
blocks.en: Routine operation: double the exposure time (the full cycle) to provide an additional safety margin

blocks.zh: 結果：理論上達到至少 10−6 的非無菌概率（PNSU）
blocks.en: Result: in theory, a probability of a non-sterile unit (PNSU) of at most 10−6

blocks.zh: 這種方法的優勢在於不需要精確測定 D 值 — 只要在半週期內確認 total kill，加倍後的安全餘量就足以保證無菌性。
blocks.en: The advantage of this approach is that the D-value does not need to be determined precisely: once total kill is confirmed at the half cycle, the safety margin from doubling is sufficient to assure sterility.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 游泳池消毒的例子：假設你測試發現，用特定濃度的消毒劑浸泡 30 分鐘就能殺死所有測試微生物。半週期法的邏輯就是：常規操作時浸泡 60 分鐘（加倍），確保即使有變異因素，也能達到足夠的滅菌保證。
blocks.en: Swimming pool disinfection example: suppose testing shows that soaking in a given concentration of disinfectant for 30 minutes kills all test microorganisms. The half-cycle logic is to soak for 60 minutes (double) in routine operation, so that sterility assurance remains adequate even with variability.

blocks.zh: 公式邏輯 Validation Logic
blocks.en: Validation Logic

blocks.zh: Bracketing Approach — 包圍法
blocks.en: Bracketing Approach

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Bracketing Method
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Bracketing Method

blocks.zh: 包圍法（Bracketing）的運作邏輯：
blocks.en: How the Bracketing approach works:

blocks.zh: High bracket（上限條件）：高於常規的濃度/溫度 — 確認不會對物料造成損害（over-treatment）
blocks.en: High bracket (upper limit condition): concentration/temperature above routine, to confirm that the material is not damaged (over-treatment)

blocks.zh: Low bracket（下限條件）：低於常規的濃度/溫度 — 確認仍然能夠殺滅微生物（under-treatment worst case）
blocks.en: Low bracket (lower limit condition): concentration/temperature below routine, to confirm that microorganisms are still killed (under-treatment worst case)

blocks.zh: Routine（常規條件）：落在上下限之間，兼顧滅菌效力與材料相容性
blocks.en: Routine (normal conditions): set between the upper and lower limits, balancing sterilization efficacy and material compatibility

blocks.zh: 這種方法比半週期法更加精確，因為它建立了完整的殺滅動力學數據（D 值），但也需要更多的實驗工作。
blocks.en: This approach is more precise than the half-cycle approach because it establishes complete kill kinetics data (D-values), but it also requires more experimental work.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Neutralization Challenge
blocks.en: Key Note: Neutralization Challenge

blocks.zh: 中和方法的關鍵挑戰：原文特別強調必須找到一種快速中和方法來在暴露後立即停止化學劑的殺滅作用。這是因為：
blocks.en: The key challenge in neutralization: the original text specifically stresses the need for a rapid neutralization method to stop the kill action of the chemical agent immediately after exposure. This is because:

blocks.zh: 許多化學滅菌劑（如 PAA）殺菌速率非常快
blocks.en: Many chemical sterilants (such as PAA) kill very rapidly

blocks.zh: 如果中和太慢，fractional kill 數據會被扭曲 — 實際暴露時間比設計的更長
blocks.en: If neutralization is too slow, fractional kill data will be distorted, because the actual exposure time is longer than designed

blocks.zh: 常見的中和劑：硫代硫酸鈉（sodium thiosulfate）用於氧化性滅菌劑；蛋白（catalase）用於 H<sub>2</sub>O<sub>2</sub>
blocks.en: Common neutralizers: sodium thiosulfate for oxidizing sterilants; catalase (an enzyme) for H<sub>2</sub>O<sub>2</sub>

blocks.zh: Equipment Qualification — 設備確效
blocks.en: Equipment Qualification

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 EQ for LPS
blocks.en: Key Concepts: EQ for LPS

blocks.zh: 設備確效在液相滅菌中相對簡單，因為所需設備通常不複雜。核心需確認的參數：
blocks.en: Equipment qualification is relatively simple for liquid-phase sterilization, because the equipment required is usually not complex. The core parameters to confirm are:

blocks.zh: IQ（安裝確效）：浸泡槽/容器的安裝符合設計規格
blocks.en: IQ (Installation Qualification): the immersion tank/vessel is installed in accordance with design specifications

blocks.zh: OQ（操作確效）：溫度控制系統能維持設定溫度；攪拌/循環系統運作正常
blocks.en: OQ (Operational Qualification): the temperature control system can hold the set temperature; the agitation/circulation system operates correctly

blocks.zh: PQ（性能確效）：在裝載條件下能均勻分布滅菌劑
blocks.en: PQ (Performance Qualification): the sterilant is distributed uniformly under loaded conditions

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：對於 SUS 流路的液相滅菌，「設備」可能只是一個泵循環系統加上溫度感測器。但仍需完成完整的 IQ/OQ/PQ 文件。
blocks.en: CDMO practice: for liquid-phase sterilization of SUS fluid paths, the "equipment" may be nothing more than a pump recirculation system with temperature sensors. Complete IQ/OQ/PQ documentation is still required.

blocks.zh: Component & Load Definition — 組件與裝載定義
blocks.en: Component & Load Definition

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Surface Contact
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Surface Contact

blocks.zh: 液相滅菌是表面現象（surface phenomenon） — 這是本章最重要的原則之一。化學滅菌劑必須與所有待滅菌表面直接接觸才能產生效果。
blocks.en: Liquid-phase sterilization is a surface phenomenon, which is one of the most important principles of this chapter. The chemical sterilant must come into direct contact with every surface to be sterilized in order to be effective.

blocks.zh: 關鍵挑戰：
blocks.en: Key challenges:

blocks.zh: Needle lumens / 針頭管腔：內徑極小，滅菌劑可能無法完全滲入
blocks.en: Needle lumens: the inner diameter is very small, so the sterilant may not fully penetrate

blocks.zh: Closely fitted parts / 緊密配合部件：接觸面之間可能形成死角
blocks.en: Closely fitted parts: dead spaces may form between contact surfaces

blocks.zh: Porous materials / 多孔材料：內部孔隙需要滅菌劑滲透
blocks.en: Porous materials: the sterilant must penetrate the internal pores

blocks.zh: 重點提示 CDMO SUS Application
blocks.en: Key Note: CDMO SUS Application

blocks.zh: SUS 流路滅菌的裝載定義：在 CDMO 無菌充填操作中，使用過氧乙酸滅菌 SUS 流路時，「maximum load」指的是最長的管路配置、最多的連接點、最複雜的歧管（manifold）。驗證時必須使用此最劣情境（worst case）。
blocks.en: Load definition for SUS fluid path sterilization: in CDMO aseptic filling operations, when sterilizing SUS fluid paths with peracetic acid, the "maximum load" means the longest tubing configuration, the most connection points, and the most complex manifold. Validation must use this worst case.

blocks.zh: 循環/攪拌的重要性：對 SUS 流路而言，泵送循環（recirculation）確保滅菌劑能到達所有內表面，包括 T 型接頭、閥門死角和管路彎曲處。靜態浸泡在複雜流路中是不夠的。
blocks.en: The importance of circulation/agitation: for SUS fluid paths, pumped recirculation ensures that the sterilant reaches all internal surfaces, including T-connectors, valve dead spaces, and tubing bends. Static immersion is not sufficient in a complex fluid path.

blocks.zh: Biological Indicators — 生物指示劑
blocks.en: Biological Indicators

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 BI Selection
blocks.en: Key Concepts: BI Selection

blocks.zh: 為什麼選用 B. atrophaeus / B. subtilis？
blocks.en: Why choose B. atrophaeus / B. subtilis?

blocks.zh: 這兩種都是嗜溫性（mesophilic）芽孢形成菌
blocks.en: Both are mesophilic spore-forming organisms

blocks.zh: 它們代表了實際生產環境中最可能遇到的最劣情境生物負載
blocks.en: They represent the worst-case bioburden most likely to be encountered in the actual production environment

blocks.zh: 注意：這與蒸氣滅菌使用耐熱的 Geobacillus stearothermophilus 不同 — 因為液相滅菌通常在較低溫度下進行
blocks.en: Note: this differs from steam sterilization, which uses the heat-resistant Geobacillus stearothermophilus, because liquid-phase sterilization is usually performed at lower temperatures

blocks.zh: 直接接種法（Direct Inoculation）：孢子挑戰直接接種在待滅菌物品上，而非使用市售 BI 載體。這更能反映實際滅菌條件。
blocks.en: Direct Inoculation: the spore challenge is inoculated directly onto the item to be sterilized, rather than using a commercial BI carrier. This better reflects the actual sterilization conditions.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Placement Strategy
blocks.en: Key Note: Placement Strategy

blocks.zh: 原文明確指出：BI 應放置在化學劑最難到達的位置（hardest to reach）。這些位置通常包括：
blocks.en: The original text states clearly that BIs should be placed where the chemical agent is hardest to reach. These locations typically include:

blocks.zh: 管路最遠端（furthest point from inlet）
blocks.en: The furthest point of the tubing (furthest point from inlet)

blocks.zh: T 型接頭的死腿（dead legs）
blocks.en: Dead legs at T-connectors

blocks.zh: 閥門密封面附近
blocks.en: Near valve sealing surfaces

blocks.zh: 組件的凹槽或螺紋內
blocks.en: Inside grooves or threads of components

blocks.zh: Process Confirmation / Microbiological Challenge — 製程確認 / 微生物挑戰
blocks.en: Process Confirmation / Microbiological Challenge

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Validation Core
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Validation Core

blocks.zh: 驗證活動的核心要素：
blocks.en: Core elements of the validation activities:

blocks.zh: Linear death curve / 線性死亡曲線：在半對數圖上，存活菌數 vs. 時間應呈直線 — 這確認了一級動力學假設的正確性
blocks.en: Linear death curve: on a semi-logarithmic plot, surviving count versus time should be a straight line, which confirms that the first-order kinetics assumption is correct

blocks.zh: Total kill / 完全殺滅：所有 BI 必須被殺死 — 不接受部分存活
blocks.en: Total kill: all BIs must be killed; partial survival is not accepted

blocks.zh: Replicate studies / 重複研究：業界慣例至少 3 次連續成功運行
blocks.en: Replicate studies: industry practice is at least 3 consecutive successful runs

blocks.zh: Physical measurements / 物理量測：溫度、濃度、時間等參數的紀錄作為輔助文件
blocks.en: Physical measurements: records of parameters such as temperature, concentration, and time serve as supporting documentation

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Adjustable Parameters
blocks.en: Key Note: Adjustable Parameters

blocks.zh: 當滅菌效果不理想時，可調整的製程參數包括：
blocks.en: When sterilization efficacy is unsatisfactory, the process parameters that can be adjusted include:

blocks.zh: 濃度（Concentration） — 增加化學劑濃度
blocks.en: Concentration - increase the concentration of the chemical agent

blocks.zh: 時間（Process Time） — 延長暴露時間
blocks.en: Process Time - extend the exposure time

blocks.zh: 攪拌（Agitation） — 增加混合以確保接觸
blocks.en: Agitation - increase mixing to ensure contact

blocks.zh: 溫度（Temperature） — 提高溫度以加速反應
blocks.en: Temperature - raise the temperature to speed up the reaction

blocks.zh: 但要注意：每個參數的調整都可能影響材料相容性，需要同步評估對 SUS 材料或設備的影響。
blocks.en: Note, however, that adjusting any parameter may affect material compatibility, so the impact on SUS materials or equipment must be evaluated at the same time.

blocks.zh: Agent Neutralization / Removal — 化學劑中和 / 去除
blocks.en: Agent Neutralization / Removal

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Post-Sterilization Handling
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Post-Sterilization Handling

blocks.zh: 滅菌後處理是液相滅菌最獨特也最具挑戰性的環節。兩種去除方式：
blocks.en: Post-sterilization handling is the most distinctive and most challenging part of liquid-phase sterilization. There are two ways to remove the agent:

blocks.zh: Chemical neutralization / 化學中和：使用中和劑（如硫代硫酸鈉）使滅菌劑失活。適用於難以沖洗的複雜結構
blocks.en: Chemical neutralization: use a neutralizer (such as sodium thiosulfate) to inactivate the sterilant. Suitable for complex structures that are difficult to rinse

blocks.zh: Physical removal / 物理去除：使用無菌水或 WFI 沖洗去除滅菌劑殘留。更常用於 SUS 流路
blocks.en: Physical removal: rinse with sterile water or WFI to remove sterilant residues. More commonly used for SUS fluid paths

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Sterility Maintenance
blocks.en: Key Note: Sterility Maintenance

blocks.zh: 維持無菌狀態的關鍵要求：
blocks.en: Key requirements for maintaining sterility:

blocks.zh: 去除/中和過程本身必須在無菌條件下進行 — 否則剛滅菌的物品會被重新污染
blocks.en: The removal/neutralization process itself must be performed under sterile conditions, otherwise the freshly sterilized items will be recontaminated

blocks.zh: 需要無菌製程模擬（Process Simulation / Media Fill）來驗證從滅菌完成到放入密封容器的整個過程
blocks.en: A process simulation (media fill) is needed to validate the entire process from completion of sterilization to placement in a sealed container

blocks.zh: 沖洗用的水必須是無菌水或 WFI
blocks.en: The rinse water must be sterile water or WFI

blocks.zh: 所有接觸已滅菌物品的設備和容器都必須是預先滅菌的
blocks.en: All equipment and containers that contact the sterilized items must be pre-sterilized

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務提示：對於 SUS 流路的 PAA 滅菌後沖洗，通常使用無菌 WFI 經由同一泵系統進行循環沖洗，並透過 TOC（Total Organic Carbon）或 pH 測試確認殘留去除的完整性。沖洗後的排放物需要進行殘留測試以確認符合限值。
blocks.en: CDMO practice tip: for the rinse after PAA sterilization of SUS fluid paths, sterile WFI is usually recirculated through the same pump system, and the completeness of residue removal is confirmed by TOC (Total Organic Carbon) or pH testing. The rinse effluent must be tested for residues to confirm compliance with limits.

blocks.zh: Routine Process Control — 日常製程管控
blocks.en: Routine Process Control

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Cross-Reference
blocks.en: Key Note: Cross-Reference

blocks.zh: 本節提到的日常管控原則直接引用 USP 〈1229〉（母章）的通用要求。這表示液相滅菌與其他滅菌方式（蒸氣、乾熱、輻射等）共享相同的 GMP 管控框架 — 差異只在於具體的製程參數和監測項目。
blocks.en: The routine control principles in this section directly refer to the general requirements of USP <1229> (the parent chapter). This means liquid-phase sterilization shares the same GMP control framework as other sterilization methods (steam, dry heat, radiation, etc.); the differences lie only in the specific process parameters and monitoring items.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Maintaining Validated State
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Maintaining Validated State

blocks.zh: 維持驗證狀態（Validated State）的七大要素：
blocks.en: The seven elements of maintaining the Validated State:

blocks.zh: References — 參考文獻
blocks.en: References

blocks.zh: 延伸閱讀建議
blocks.en: Suggested Further Reading

blocks.zh: 本章僅有 3 篇參考文獻，反映其作為 USP 通則的精簡特性。建議同時參閱：
blocks.en: This chapter has only 3 references, which reflects its concise nature as a USP general chapter. It is advisable to also consult:

blocks.zh: USP 〈1229〉 — 滅菌總則（母章），建立所有滅菌方式的通用框架
blocks.en: USP <1229> - general chapter on sterilization (the parent chapter), establishing the common framework for all sterilization methods

blocks.zh: USP 〈1229.7〉 — 氣相滅菌，半週期法的原始出處
blocks.en: USP <1229.7> - gaseous sterilization, the original source of the half-cycle approach

blocks.zh: USP 〈1211〉 — 無菌保證，包含滅菌後處理要求
blocks.en: USP <1211> - sterility assurance, including post-sterilization handling requirements

blocks.zh: PIC/S Annex 1 — 無菌藥品製造的歐盟/PIC/S 法規要求
blocks.en: PIC/S Annex 1 - EU/PIC/S regulatory requirements for the manufacture of sterile medicinal products

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: Liquid-Phase Sterilization（液相滅菌）是將物品浸泡在化學滅菌劑溶液中，利用化學方式破壞微生物的滅菌方法 — 主要為表面滅菌（surface phenomenon）
blocks.en: Liquid-Phase Sterilization is a sterilization method in which items are immersed in a solution of a chemical sterilant, which chemically destroys microorganisms; it is primarily surface sterilization (a surface phenomenon)

blocks.zh: 五大化學滅菌劑類別：醛類、酸類、鹼類、含氧化合物、鹵化物 — CDMO 最常用的是過氧乙酸（Peracetic Acid, PAA）
blocks.en: The five classes of chemical sterilants: aldehydes, acids, bases, oxygenating compounds, halides; the one most used in CDMOs is peracetic acid (PAA)

blocks.zh: 兩種驗證策略：半週期法（Half-Cycle，簡單、保守、加倍安全餘量）與包圍法（Bracketing，精確、建立完整動力學數據）
blocks.en: Two validation strategies: Half-Cycle (simple, conservative, doubled safety margin) and Bracketing (precise, establishes complete kinetics data)

blocks.zh: BI 選擇：B. atrophaeus（ATCC 9372）或 B. subtilis（ATCC 6633），直接接種在待滅菌物品上
blocks.en: BI selection: B. atrophaeus (ATCC 9372) or B. subtilis (ATCC 6633), inoculated directly onto the item to be sterilized

blocks.zh: 滅菌後處理：化學劑的中和或去除是液相滅菌最獨特的挑戰 — 必須在無菌條件下進行，並通過製程模擬驗證
blocks.en: Post-sterilization handling: neutralization or removal of the chemical agent is the most distinctive challenge of liquid-phase sterilization; it must be performed under sterile conditions and validated through process simulation

blocks.zh: 日常管控：與所有滅菌方式共享 USP 〈1229〉 的通用要求：校正、量測、製程管控、變更管控、維護、定期評估、培訓
blocks.en: Routine control: shares the general requirements of USP <1229> with all sterilization methods: calibration, measurement, process control, change control, maintenance, periodic review, training

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: Your CDMO is implementing PAA-based sterilization for SUS fluid paths. Using the half-cycle approach, describe the validation study design: what BI would you use, where would you place them, and what constitutes a successful validation? / 你的 CDMO 正在導入 PAA 液相滅菌用於 SUS 流路。使用半週期法，描述驗證研究設計：你會使用什麼 BI、放置在哪裡、什麼構成成功的驗證？
blocks.en: Your CDMO is implementing PAA-based sterilization for SUS fluid paths. Using the half-cycle approach, describe the validation study design: what BI would you use, where would you place them, and what constitutes a successful validation?

blocks.zh: Why is agent neutralization/removal considered part of the sterilization process in liquid-phase sterilization but not in steam sterilization? What are the implications for process simulation? / 為什麼在液相滅菌中，化學劑的中和/去除被視為滅菌製程的一部分，但在蒸氣滅菌中則不是？這對製程模擬有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why is agent neutralization/removal considered part of the sterilization process in liquid-phase sterilization but not in steam sterilization? What are the implications for process simulation?

blocks.zh: Compare the half-cycle and bracketing approaches: when would you choose one over the other for a CDMO operation? Consider factors such as development time, scientific rigor, and regulatory expectations. / 比較半週期法與包圍法：在 CDMO 營運中，你何時會選擇其中之一？考慮開發時間、科學嚴謹性和法規期望等因素。
blocks.en: Compare the half-cycle and bracketing approaches: when would you choose one over the other for a CDMO operation? Consider factors such as development time, scientific rigor, and regulatory expectations.
